title: The workbench GitHub page
text: Current observations: One page in every mode: App installations with a Manage on GitHub link to repository-access settings, personal authorization when one is known, and project mappings. Hosted marks installation facts live. Local and self-hosted show when each installation was last checked; Check now runs projects.github_binding.check for every bound project in scope and names any refusal's reason and recovery. Facts the page cannot read are hidden, never shown as unavailable. Installation bound counts cover all visible projects, independent of the selected mapping scope. Hosted installation rows combine the host list with every binding-derived installation; an absent hosted entry is explained and still shows its bound count and disabled Detach. Unbind confirms removal of the mapping, capability and secrets; its result teaches that issue sync is off and how to bind and enable it again. Hosted service inventory uses projects.github_binding.list with org authority and an optional installation filter. The unbind domain result owns the sync-mode notice displayed by the page. Desired hosted teaching: each GitHub account installation serves exactly one hosted Yoke org. Connect explicitly reviews the GitHub account and all or selected repository access even when only one installation is available. A second org's Connect refuses github_installation_owned, names the owning org, and teaches the recovery: unbind every project and then Detach from the old org before connecting to the new org in the same environment; do not uninstall the App from GitHub for this move. Installing from GitHub directs the person to finish from the organization's GitHub page. This exclusive ownership applies to hosted orgs; local and self-hosted retain their access checks. Hosted CLI binds, including onboarding, and dashboard binds pass Platform admin and installation-ownership checks before the hosted_service identity binds in the engine. Direct member and machine engine binds refuse github_binding_hosted_only and teach the hosted org or Connect GitHub recovery. Local and self-hosted universes without that identity retain project-admin and GitHub access checks.
verification: Hosted ownership and org function-door routing are delivered by the companion Platform change. Engine enforcement is observed in source and covered by focused authority tests; live proof awaits engine delivery.
